nodes.label: Request

nodes.label: Provenance

nodes.label: Value Flow

nodes.label: Trust Boundary

nodes.label: Consent

nodes.label: Agent

nodes.label: Callable tool (agent-facing)

nodes.label: Memory

nodes.label: Retrieval Index

nodes.label: Guardrail

nodes.label: Initiative

nodes.def: An action whose primary effect is to observe or retrieve without changing business state.

nodes.label: Write Action

nodes.label: Execute Action
nodes.def: An action that runs code, a command or a process in the environment.

nodes.label: Value Transfer Action
nodes.def: An action that moves money or another measurable value out of the enterprise.

nodes.def: An action that formally accepts a request and releases it to proceed.

nodes.def: An action that removes or cancels an authority, credential or access that previously existed.

nodes.label: Data Disclosure Effect

nodes.label: Persistent privilege state

nodes.label: Unverified Identity

nodes.label: Integrity

nodes.label: Availability

nodes.label: Authorized Action

nodes.label: Value Ceiling
